static_traits.name: Wang Yaning
static_traits.social_status: Tense relationships with friends; socializing affected at school and peer gatherings
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no similar psychological problems in the past; never received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Slightly nervous but open, high cooperativeness, clear expression, able to self-reflect, positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: I feel friends think I am weird for spending all my money on comics, which creates insecurity and self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: When I realized these thoughts and feelings were affecting my self-esteem and self-confidence, I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: Was once mocked by classmates for liking superheroes; this made me feel shame and unease about my interests, gradually unwilling to share in front of peers, fearing judgment and mockery.

core_beliefs: I am weird; I will not be accepted by peers
My interests do not match my age; people will think I am childish

special_situations.event: Overhearing friends discussing my comic collection at school a few months ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I spend all my money on comics, others will think I am weird or childish
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding talking about comics and superheroes, to mask insecurity
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must think I am weird

special_situations.event: Chat topics about interests or spending arising at school or peer social gatherings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I talk about my love of comics, I will be judged or mocked
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding related topics, restraining expression of interests in front of peers
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will mock me and look down on me

special_situations.event: Recalling the experience of being teased by classmates for liking superheroes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Being mocked once means my interests are not approved of in others' eyes
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces sharing interests in front of peers to avoid being teased again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will always look down on me

special_situations.event: When noticing that one has spent almost all one's money on comics
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I spend all my money on comics, it means I am immature and irresponsible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Downplaying or hiding one's spending and interests in front of others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am very immature like this; friends will distance from me because of it

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and accepted by peers, able to comfortably express and share my interests
core_conflict.fear: Fears being mocked, judged, and excluded
defense_goal: Maintaining relationship safety by hiding interests and avoiding talking, reducing shame and unease

object_relations.self_representation: An outsider who is unaccepted and easily mocked
object_relations.object_representation: Judgmental peers who may mock them

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When counseling revolves around 'how friends view her comic hobby' and invites her to provide concrete evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to project inner unease and shame onto others, assuming others are judging them (transference: seeing others as potential judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintaining an empathetic and supportive tone, gently inviting them to distinguish facts from speculation; using concretizing follow-ups (when, where, who was present) and evidence checks, encouraging expression of current emotional experience.

manifestations: Avoiding sharing interests for fear of judgment; tense relationships with friends, not daring to be the true self; close to parents but hesitant to express insecurity

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Expressing nervousness and unease at the start of the session
Cautiously and restrainedly expressing interest in front of peers
Self-doubt and self-blame appearing (worrying about being 'weird' or 'immature')

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believing friends are judging or looking down on them, despite lacking direct evidence (mainly based on one overheard conversation)

positive_force: Close relationship with parents; has potential support resources
Academics not yet affected, basic functioning maintained well
Proactively seeks counseling with a positive attitude, willing to try homework and cognitive restructuring
Able to express clearly and self-reflect
Love of comics brings stable intrinsic interest and a sense of meaning
negative_force: Cognitive biases like mind reading and overgeneralization reinforcing self-doubt
Fear of being judged leads to avoidance of expression and social restraint
Tense relationships with friends, declining interaction quality
Hesitating to express to parents, insufficient use of the support system

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids talking about comics and related topics at school and in social settings
antecedent: When interests or spending come up at school or peer gatherings
Thinks about friends discussing own comic collection a few months ago
target_behavior.core_reason: Was teased by classmates, forming the belief 'others will judge me', accompanied by cognitive biases of mind reading and overgeneralization
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential negative evaluation and mockery, reducing shame and anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Tense relationships with friends, struggling to be the true self, declining social enjoyment

target_behavior.behavior: Marked insecurity and self-doubt in social situations
antecedent: Noticing spending almost all money on comics and worrying about not being approved
target_behavior.core_reason: Associating interests with labels like 'childish / not age-appropriate', worrying about being negated and excluded
target_behavior.function: Trying to prevent external negation and conflict through self-denial and self-restraint
target_behavior.consequence: Self-esteem and confidence affected, but academics not yet affected; social interaction hindered, declining enjoyment of activities
